description: This Java source file defines the main activity for a Bluetooth chat application on Android. It manages Bluetooth connections, user interface interactions for messaging, and communicates with a BluetoothChatService to handle the Bluetooth protocol. The class includes setup methods, lifecycle management, message handling, and menu actions specific to Bluetooth chat functionality.

classes.name: BluetoothChat
classes.description: Main activity handling Bluetooth chat UI, Bluetooth connection lifecycle, and message exchange.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and checks for Bluetooth support.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Checks if Bluetooth is enabled, requests enabling if not.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth chat service if appropriate.

methods.name: setupChat
methods.description: Initializes UI components and Bluetooth service for chatting.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Lifecycle method; currently logs pause event.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Lifecycle method; currently logs stop event.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Stops Bluetooth chat service and cleans up on activity destruction.

methods.name: ensureDiscoverable
methods.description: Makes the device discoverable via Bluetooth.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a text message over an active Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: mWriteListener
methods.description: Listener for the send message input for handling return key events.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the ActionBar subtitle with connection status.

methods.name: mHandler
methods.description: Handles messages from BluetoothChatService for UI updates and notifications.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from Bluetooth device selection and enable requests.

methods.name: connectDevice
methods.description: Initiates connection to a selected Bluetooth device.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for Bluetooth actions.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions like scanning and enabling discoverability.
